platform.name: Property Source Exchange
platform.category: Global white-label real estate marketplace and transaction platform
platform.summary: Connects independent branded real estate marketplaces into a shared network for property discovery, digital transactions, lenders, title companies, auctions, and related services.

network_counts.note: Counts displayed by the official website and subject to change.

strategic_partner_relationship: Property Source Exchange identifies every organization in strategic_partners as a strategic platform partner participating in its global real estate exchange ecosystem.

buyer.revenue_share_recipient: Owner of the independent marketplace hosting the buyer

seller.revenue_share_recipient: Owner of the independent marketplace hosting the seller

advertising.audience: Members of that specific independent marketplace

revenue_model.transaction_trigger: Completed property sale, not a listing or an offer

same_marketplace_example.condition: The same marketplace hosts both the seller and buyer of the completed property sale

cross_marketplace_example.attribution: Each independent marketplace receives the share associated with its own member.

ambassador.description: Earn an ongoing 5% ambassador share from transaction activity generated by each new independent marketplace you refer to the exchange.
ambassador.beneficiary: Marketplace owner who refers a new independent marketplace to the exchange

revenue_model.evergreen_condition: The relevant marketplaces remain active and transacting

ai_resources.structured_data: Embedded Schema.org JSON-LD in the canonical homepage

ai_powered_exchange.headline: The network is the power. AI is the multiplier.
ai_powered_exchange.summary: Property Hub Exchange puts AI to work across Property Source Exchange—from recruiting marketplace partners and sourcing property opportunities to member support, analysis, and transaction coordination. The real strength is the people and opportunities in the network. AI orchestrates the information, reduces friction, and helps buyers and sellers move forward across connected marketplaces worldwide.

capabilities.headline: Growth that never sleeps.
capabilities.description: Conversational AI agents reach marketplace partners, property owners, and wholesalers—helping bring new communities and property deals into the exchange.

capabilities.headline: Answers in every channel.
capabilities.description: From text chat and live on-platform voice conversations to phone support, AI agents guide members through navigation, technical questions, and the next step.

capabilities.headline: Intelligence behind every deal.
capabilities.description: AI helps analyze properties, lenders, and relevant information—organizing complex data into useful insights that support more informed decisions.

capabilities.headline: An always-on operating layer.
capabilities.description: AI agents take on routine outreach, support, and coordination duties, creating a scalable 24/7 digital workforce that helps streamline transactions worldwide.

external_investor_agents.design_goal: The exchange is designed to help investor-operated AI agents discover and work with property deals through connected, machine-readable interfaces. AI inside the platform and agents outside it can support a more connected real estate ecosystem.
external_investor_agents.access_note: External-agent access depends on the supported integration and its permissions.
